camera.title: Photograph a diary page
camera.description: Tomorrow's page? Hold steady, we will read it.
camera.guide: Place the diary page flat in good light.
camera.privacy: Photos stay in India and are deleted per your retention settings.
camera.captured: {count, plural, one {# page captured} other {# pages captured}}
camera.offline: Saved on this device. Will read when you're back online.

hints.glare: Glare on the page. Tilt it away from the light.

errors.open: Couldn't open the camera. Choose photos instead.
errors.process: Couldn't prepare this photo. Try again.
errors.save: Couldn't save this page on the device.

denied.title: Camera access is off
denied.body: You can still add photos from your gallery.
denied.steps: To use the camera, allow camera access for this site in your browser settings, then open this again.

crop.title: Adjust the page edges
crop.hint: Drag the four corners to the page edges. Arrow keys move a corner 4 px, Shift moves 16 px.

review.title: Review pages
review.upload: Upload {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}

recover.title: Pick up where you left off
recover.body: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} from an earlier session are saved on this device.

causeList.title: This looks like a cause list
causeList.copy: Printed cause lists are read by list import, not as a diary page.

receipt.title: Kept as an attachment
receipt.copy: Kept as an attachment. Fee tracking arrives later.
